notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company (B2B SaaS PM tool). Started with Hosted API POC for embeddings + chat in Q4 2025; moved to Dedicated evaluation after predictable throughput and costs became priority. Team: CTO (A. Morales), Head of ML (R. Chen), Product (K. Dawson). AE Jordan Kim working with SE Priya Shah and IPR/legal support.

Key requirements (client-said):
- Strong cost predictability with committed monthly capacity (need contract templates for commit levels: 2M, 5M, 12M tokens/month).
- Burst capacity of at least 3x baseline for seasonal onboarding spikes; want clear overage pricing and soft throttles.
- Latency SLA target: p95 < 300ms for short chat flows (<=128 tokens).
- Throughput: 20 concurrent chat sessions sustained per region initially; plan to scale 2-3x over 6 months.
- Model preferences: open Llama-family variants + Redwood-verified smaller fallbacks. Interested in quantized variants if accuracy retained.
- Routing/fallback: prefer primary in us-west with fallback to us-east; automatic model downgrade on sustained capacity pressure.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 12 months, data residency in US only.

- 2025-12-02: Hosted API POC (2 weeks) for search/embedding; integrated vector store, measured RTT and token consumption. Notes: average token spend 1.4x estimate on user prompts.

- 2026-02-25: Provided draft pricing scenarios (2M/5M/12M commit) + sample ramp (Q2->Q3 Q4). Sent pricing deck: /drive/pinegrove/presentations/redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.pdf

Current status: Negotiating Dedicated contract terms. Pinegrove is leaning toward a 12M token/month commit with a 6-month ramp (start 50% first month -> 75% second -> 100% month 3). They want burst that allows 2-4x sustained for first 90 days with predictable overage caps. Pricing sensitivity: aim to keep blended unit cost under $0.0008/token after commit discounts.
